FROM
Analyst S. Hale, Puget Cell
TO
Special Agent D. Okafor
DATE
11/10/2026
REF.
SEA-0411
CLASSIFICATION
FIRSTLIGHT / CONFIDENTIAL / DO NOT FORWARD
SUBJECT
Source ARCHER, second delivery

  1. The anonymous source designated ARCHER has delivered a second sample through the agreed channel. Provisional reliability: B-2 (usually reliable; information probably true). The source claims to have access “to the local structure” and to know its hierarchy.

  2. The sample includes three locations of interest:

    a) Rural property in the Snohomish Valley, with a private boat landing.

    b) Industrial hangar on Harbor Island, registered to a dormant logistics company.

    c) Penthouse in a residential building on Capitol Hill, registered to a cultural foundation.

  3. All three match areas flagged in episode 112 of the podcast “What the City Forgets” (WARD, Helen). Recommend increasing passive surveillance on WARD. Direct contact not recommended at this time.

  4. The source claims to be able to deliver, within the next few days, “the complete index” of a private archive documenting ten years of incidents in the area. If so, it would be the cell's biggest find since its creation.

  5. Separately: surveillance continues on statistical anomaly no. 1 (M.E. signature “R. A.,” King County office, 15 reports with an inconsistent pattern).

  6. Open question: why is the source giving us this? Every source wants something. Until we know what ARCHER wants, I propose treating its deliveries as possible bait.

— S. H.

Format: encrypted email, printed. When: @UUID[JournalEntry.C7cxKf7kcAELzuJ1.JournalEntryPage.EjJ0vfVBCjTTb0QV]{A3-E02 · The Data Center}, on the Gale Sentinel servers (@UUID[JournalEntry.j32Ohis1qKJB3jcx.JournalEntryPage.wRvr7GFOMQsgTJ2z]{SEA-0411 Shipments / DOC-07}), or in @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.uL8F2YNogcToiFc6]{A2-E01 · Elysium Night} if Voight (@UUID[JournalEntry.yaAsxCkCLf8CANL5]{Dr. Anneliese Voight}) trusts the coterie.

Foreshadows: the existence of Halloway's mole and the raid's target list (@UUID[JournalEntry.doItxeK8y7M1PufU.JournalEntryPage.ogKpm1VYgcVGCw1T]{A4-E02 · The Raid}).

Truth: the source ARCHER is Halloway, working through Preston Gale. Every address points to assets belonging to Whitmore, Montgomery, or David. None points to Halloway. If Ruth (@UUID[JournalEntry.gRfqeOIXEHOcLemr]{Dr. Ruth Abernathy}) is in play, the “anomaly” is her; if not, it's an NPC medical examiner.
